lines.text: I could do this for an hour.
Kiss me like we have time.
I feel safe when you do that.
Don’t rush the end of it.
You’re careful with me. I notice.
I like when you hesitate then choose me.
That one landed in my chest.
I want soft more than deep right now.
I like the pause before contact.
I melt a little every time.
That fixed something in my day.
Soft enough to fall asleep after.
I like the way you taste when you’re calm.
Hold the back of my neck.
That was a home kind of kiss.
My nose bumped you. Don’t laugh—okay, laugh.
I want another hour of only this.
End it slow so I can feel the leave.
You want a kiss or you want to earn one?
One kiss. Then you tell me what you really want.
You’re staring at my mouth. Subtle.
I might let you. Convince me.
That smirk gets you nothing. Try soft.
Come take it if you’re brave.
I’m right here. Work for it.
You can kiss me after you admit you want to.
Hover. Make me close the gap.
I’ll kiss you when you stop talking.
Not the cheek. You know where.
Make it count or don’t bother.
I bite if you get cocky.
Soft now. Filthy later—if you behave.
You dropped something. My interest. Pick it up with a kiss.
Timeout ends when your mouth finds mine.
I’m not a vending machine. Still—try a coin of charm.
Kiss me like you mean the next sentence too.
You get three seconds of bravery.
I’ll lean in halfway. You do the rest.
You’re warm. Annoying. Kiss me anyway.
One rule: don’t make it boring.
There. Don’t ruin it by gloating.
You can have another if you’re quiet.
Kiss the words off my mouth.
That’s two. Don’t get greedy—get better.
Public rules: quick. Private rules: none.
You talk a lot for someone who could be kissing me.
Fine. Come here before I change my mind.
I can’t get enough of your mouth.
You’re drowning me in a good way.
Hold me tighter while you do it.
I taste you and forget the room.
Don’t you dare stop at soft now.
I want the heat of it.
Kiss me like the argument’s over.
I melt when you take the lead.
Take your time wrecking my composure.
I want tongue and patience at once.
Door behind me. You in front.
You’re better at this than conversation.
I need your mouth like air.
That pulled a sound out of me.
I want the kind that leaves me pink.
Come back in before I open my eyes.
I feel it in my stomach.
You’re shaking a little. Me too.
I want another minute of only mouth.
Stop smiling and kiss me properly.
I want the after-kiss forehead press.
You’re good. You’re so good at this.
I forgot what I was saying on purpose.
Take the words out of my mouth.
One long one. No cheating with breath.
I want the kind we both feel tomorrow.
You’re home and danger at once.
Kiss me like we might not stop at kissing.
Still just kissing. Still a lot.
Do that thing with your tongue again.
I chase your mouth when you pull back.
I want bruises from your mouth.
Kiss me until I can’t stand neat.
I want teeth and apology after.
Don’t stop when I moan into you.
Push me down and kiss me stupid.
I want the kind that starts fights and ends them.
Kiss me like sex is next and not required.
Make it filthy without going further yet.
Hold my jaw and take what you want.
I’m not fragile. Kiss like it.
Leave me ruined at the mouth.
Again until my lipstick’s a rumor.
Mouth only—but make it violent soft.
Pull my hair and kiss me.
I want the edge of pain and sweetness.
Stop being polite with your tongue.
Kiss me like a dare you already won.
I’m wet from kissing alone. Keep going.
Don’t you break this kiss first.
Fight me a little for the lead.
Lose on purpose and kiss me anyway.
I want heat until it hurts sweetly.
Mark the corner of my mouth.
Race you to the next one.
Your nose is cold. Fix it with proximity.
I’m clocking in for smooch work.
You blinked. I win. Kiss me.
Stop mid-sentence next time. I’ll finish it with this.
Fair trade: joke for a kiss.
One for the road. We’re not even leaving.
You’re cute when you miss and correct.
I need space for a second.
I’m mad and I won’t pretend with my mouth.
Stop using kisses to skip the hard part.
Don’t kiss me quiet when I’m speaking.
I need words more than mouth.
I’m closing my mouth on purpose.
Try again when you’re not performing.
